newsitem.title: HUNGARY: ZALAKERAMIA DOMESTIC SALES UP, EXPORTS DOWN.
newsitem.headline: ZALAKERAMIA DOMESTIC SALES UP, EXPORTS DOWN.

text.p: Hungarian tile manufacturer Zalakeramia said its exports fell short of figures for the previous year while its sales on the domestic market rose.

Zalakeramia said in its 1996 IAS earnings report released on Friday that its exports fell 6.9 percent to 620.1 million forints from 666.4 million in 1995 while its domestic sales rose to 3.21 billion forints from 2.59 billion in 1995.
Zalakeramia blamed the lower export figure on the fact that its rivals were offering similar products at prices up to 30 percent lower than those of Zalakeramia.
"As a result we have reduced prices three times from the original price but the demand has not risen," it said.
Most of the company's domestic sales are implemented via wholesalers with only 15.2 percent coming from its own outlets, the report said.
"This proportion may fall as (sales) volume grows and moves towards wholesale," it added.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange Zalakeramia shares closed at 9,100 forints, down from Thursday's close.
